patent_title: Process for producing carbon fibers from PAN
Process for producing high strength carbon fibers
A kind of preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-radical high-strength high-modules carbon fibre
claim_text: A preparation method of polyacrylonitrile-based high-strength and high-modulus carbon fiber, which is prepared from polyacrylonitrile precursors through pre-oxidation, low-temperature carbonization, high-temperature carbonization and high-temperature graphitization, and is characterized in that: described high-temperature carbonization is the process of low-temperature The carbonized fiber is subjected to pre-orientation treatment of stretched carbon crystallites at a certain temperature, so that the orientation angle of the high-temperature carbonized fiber carbon crystallites is not greater than 17.5°
